newsitem.title: USA: TCI in pact with Disney.
newsitem.headline: TCI in pact with Disney.

text.p: ENGLEWOOD, Colo., April 8 - Tele-Comunications Inc's TCI Communications Inc unit Tuesday said it reached a series of agreements with various subsidiaries of Walt Disney Co and the Hearst Corp.

In a statement, TCI said the agreements cover carriage of Disney Channel, ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNEWS and a number of broadcast stations owned and operated by Disney's ABC unit and by Hearst. As part of these agreements, Disney has given TCI Communications the flexibility to carry the Disney Channel on various service tiers throughout its cable television systems.
Specific terms of the agreements were not disclosed.
